scope: Exploratory formula-written weights, no training, distillation, copied weights, or data-fitted coefficients.

pilot.selection: Retain axis selector and code sizes 5 and 10 for fresh evaluation. Pilot inspected positive MSE, coverage, total MSE, inactive RMSE and fourth-power loss; this is development, not a preregistered experiment.

evaluation.prediction: Raw network output, without external clipping or projection for either contestant. Same inputs and targets for every applicable model.

bottleneck.competence: Per-feature positive MSE <0.05, unit self-gain >=0.25, correct unit-probe argmax. Report existing participation metrics separately.
bottleneck.baselines: All 30 saved scalar networks at step 100000; focus on matched ReLU L2 and L4, retain all activations.

binary.baselines: All 120 saved final networks, within their original family/task. Include exact posterior as an explicitly unconstrained reference.

caveats: Constructors know the task distribution and binary encoder; trained nets learn from examples. This tests weight construction, not equally informed learning algorithms.
Random code geometry is fixed-seed and algebraically inverted; pseudoinverse is not a fit to training examples.
Fresh seeds quantify evaluation-set variation, not uncertainty over construction seeds or learning algorithms.
Coupled threshold decoders discard neighboring evidence; their shortfall against trained denoisers must be reported.
No candidate changes after fresh evaluation. Geometry p is outside this task-performance experiment.
